title: Positive Feedback: Love the new agent slash command feature /agent
body:
Just wanted to tell the team that the new slash command feature for agents is AWESOME SAUCE!!!!! Makes it so much easier to manage and understand agents. 
- Fixed permission issues on the fly
- Provided a comprehensive health report with actionable recommendations
- Gave a clear scoring system (85/100)
- Identified and resolved issues proactively

Now I can easily setup my AI raid agent offense. Air Raid offense is the American Football offense designed by Hal Mumme and perfected by the late great coach Mike Leach.
author: thecatfix
